psychological_meaning: Norway, a muted, earthy green, evokes a sense of calm and tranquility. It is often associated with nature, growth, and stability. This color suggests a grounded and reliable personality, conveying a feeling of peacefulness and harmony. It can also represent renewal and resilience.
